name: Shobab (son with Bathsheba)
title: Son of David
summary: Shobab was one of the sons of King David and Bathsheba, born in Jerusalem. He is mentioned in genealogies but played no prominent role in biblical history compared to his brother Solomon.

keyEvents.title: Born in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Shobab was one of David's sons born in Jerusalem after David became king over all Israel. He was among the children David had with Bathsheba.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shobab is included in the list of David's sons in Chronicles, which documents the royal lineage.

keyEvents.title: Children of Bathsheba
keyEvents.description: Together with Shimea, Nathan and Solomon, Zobab was one of the four sons born to Bathsheba by David in Jerusalem.
